interface.description: Wireless interface where clients connect (e.g., the AP interface).

upstream.description: Network interface connected to the upstream (e.g., LAN or WAN).

gateway.description: IP address of the gateway/router on the hotspot subnet (must be reachable from the interface).

subnet.description: Subnet for hotspot clients, in CIDR notation.

start_ip.description: First IP address to assign via DHCP.

end_ip.description: Last IP address to assign via DHCP.

dns_servers.description: DNS servers to hand out to clients (e.g., ['8.8.8.8', '8.8.4.4'] or ['gateway']).

redirect_port.description: Port used by the captive portal redirect server (HTTP).

control_port.description: Port used for communication with the authentication backend.

backend_url.description: URL of the backend authentication service (e.g., RADIUS, CoovaChilli NDS, or custom HTTP API).

backend_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a response from the backend before failing.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of concurrent hotspot clients allowed.

log_syslog.description: If true, logs are sent to syslog instead of a file.

log_file.description: Path to the log file (used only if log_syslog is false).

use_wpa_psk.description: Enable WPA-PSK (pre-shared key) authentication for the wireless network (requires compatible hardware).

wpa_psk_passphrase.description: WPA-PSK passphrase (8–63 characters). Required if use_wpa_psk is true.

use_https.description: Use HTTPS for the captive portal redirect (requires valid cert files).

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file for HTTPS.

ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file for HTTPS.

pages.description: Custom HTML pages to serve for portal events.

name.description: Page name (e.g., login, welcome, error, logout)

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the HTML file.

static_hosts.description: Static DNS entries to inject into the internal resolver (e.g., for local devices).

clients.description: List of clients with custom rate limits.

use_mac_allowlist.description: If true, only clients with MAC addresses in the allowlist are granted access.

mac_allowlist.description: List of allowed MAC addresses (if use_mac_allowlist is true).

items.description: A MAC address in the format XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX

session_timeout.description: Maximum session duration in minutes (0 = unlimited).

use_bandwidth_accounting.description: Enable per-session bandwidth accounting (required for usage-based billing).

accounting_file.description: Path to the accounting data file (used only if use_bandwidth_accounting is true).
